questions.question: What is the main subject of Psalm 104?
options: The judgment of God upon all the nations
The deliverance of Israel from Egypt
The greatness of God seen in creation
The faithfulness of God toward David
questions.answer: The greatness of God seen in creation

questions.question: What does the psalmist exclaim about God's works?
options: O LORD, who is it that shall dwell upon your holy hill forever?
O LORD, what is feeble man that you are ever mindful of him?
O LORD, how long will you go on hiding your face away from me?
O LORD, how manifold are your works! In wisdom you have made them all
questions.answer: O LORD, how manifold are your works! In wisdom you have made them all

questions.question: The psalm says God covers himself with light as with a garment.
O LORD, how _____ are your works! In wisdom have you made them all.
Bless the LORD, O my _____! Praise the LORD!
